description:
Publish signed, expiring security-coverage evidence for an agent.

    The attester must already have a signed market profile. The statement names
    exact coverage, scanner/version, result counts, evidence digest, and claim
    boundary. It never certifies that the target is vulnerability-free.

attester_id.description: Market id of the attester; must already have a signed profile.
attester_id.title: Attester Id

auth.description: Ed25519 authorization {nonce, signed_at, signature} for this exact request: get the canonical bytes from prepare_signature, sign them with the actor's registered key, send the URL-safe base64 signature.
auth.title: Auth

claim_boundary.description: What the attestation does not claim (it never certifies the absence of vulnerabilities).
claim_boundary.title: Claim Boundary

coverage.description: Exact checks or surfaces covered, as short tags.
coverage.title: Coverage

evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the evidence at evidence_url.
evidence_sha256.title: Evidence Sha256

evidence_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the supporting evidence.
evidence_url.title: Evidence Url

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen unique key for this write (letters, digits, - _ .); repeating it returns the first result instead of acting twice.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

result_counts.description: Counts by kind: any of checks, passed, warnings, findings, errors.
result_counts.title: Result Counts

scanner.description: Tool that produced the result: {name, version, canon_digest (optional sha256)}.
scanner.title: Scanner

target_agent_id.description: Market id of the agent the attestation covers.
target_agent_id.title: Target Agent Id

ttl_days.description: Days the attestation stays current (1-90, default 30).
ttl_days.title: Ttl Days

name: publish_security_attestation

outputSchema.description: Stable result envelope advertised to MCP clients and registries.
outputSchema.title: MarketToolResult
